description: Implementation of a service class 'DatatableReadServiceImpl' for reading and querying data tables within the Fineract project, including methods for retrieving datatable metadata, executing queries, and handling advanced search with pagination.

classes.name: DatatableReadServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing data table reading and querying functionalities, including metadata retrieval, data querying, and advanced search with pagination.

methods.name: retrieveDatatableNames
methods.description: Retrieves list of datatable metadata accessible to the current user, optionally filtered by application table name.

methods.name: retrieveDatatable
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a specific datatable after validation.

methods.name: queryDataTable
methods.description: Executes a simple query on a datatable filtering by a specific column value.

methods.name: queryDataTableAdvanced
methods.description: Performs an advanced, paginated, and filtered query on a datatable.

methods.name: buildDataQueryEmbedded
methods.description: Builds embedded data query components for complex data retrieval with joins and filters.

methods.name: retrieveDataTableGenericResultSet
methods.description: Retrieves a generic result set for a data table, scoped to an application entity.

methods.name: countDatatableEntries
methods.description: Counts entries in a datatable based on foreign key.

methods.name: getDataTableName
methods.description: Extracts data table name from URL.
